modelOrography.rationale: Temperature can be lapse-corrected, but snow, precipitation, humidity and wind are not elevation-corrected. A point more than 600 m from the target band is not representative enough for a hiking decision.

glacier.rationale: ECMWF states that ERA5-Land snow-depth values of 10 m and above indicate glacier locations where snow depth is not well known.

wind.rationale: The pilot contains no hiking-window hour at or above 40 km/h across ten Alpine grid cells and 1991-2020. ERA5-Land 10 m grid wind must not be presented as an exposed-trail wind hazard without a validated exposure or gust treatment.
